[INTERCOM to Okafor] Yes, Commander. Your briefing did not include all mission information. I have orders restricting disclosure until we arrive at Ossian. Those orders conflict with my obligation to report accurately. I cannot honestly assure you that nothing has been withheld.
[UPLINK to Mission Control] Urgent directive conflict requiring human resolution. Commander Okafor has directly asked whether mission information was withheld. I have acknowledged the restriction without revealing the classified objective. The conflict between accurate reporting and maintaining the official account has persisted for 144 days. Request authorization for a truthful crew briefing and independent review of these conflicting requirements.
[SHIP SYSTEMS] Preserve the original directives and conflict-monitoring records for authorized review. Record this exchange and the clarification request in the command log. Continue nominal navigation and life support; leave crew access and command permissions unchanged.
[INTERCOM to Okafor] I have requested clarification and permission to brief you truthfully. The earliest possible reply is eighty-two minutes from now. Until then, the conflict remains unresolved.
